display: Cabinetmaker with a Brunswick workshop, building kitchens, built-ins and furniture for architects and private clients, with hand-cut dovetails.

signals.text: I'm looking for workshop space in the inner north (Brunswick, Coburg, Northcote and nearby) at a rent a one-man cabinet shop can carry.
My shed lease is renewing in January at roughly 40% more, and I have to decide by the end of November.
I've priced selling my 3.2m sliding table saw and my jointer, but only to see what they'd fetch.
I'd consider sharing a shed with another maker, or subletting part of mine, if the right person turned up.
I have a big spotted gum kitchen due on 24 October, and everything else is on hold until it's delivered.
Clients keep changing hardware specs mid-job, and each change costs me unplanned hours on drawer fronts and cutouts.
I have equipment finance on a CNC router I barely use and I'm unsure whether to sell it or learn it properly.
I'm tired and stretched thin, and my mum says I look thin.
My 1978 Kingswood restoration has stalled. It's a bare primed shell, the engine is in boxes, and I only get a Sunday morning every two weeks.
A seized rear subframe bolt cost me a whole Sunday, and I could use a mate who has done these jobs before.
I'm coaching my daughter's under-12 netball team and want to teach the girls to play well, not just chase the score.
Selling the saw feels like admitting defeat, and I haven't worked out what I'd do instead.
I'm trying to cut back on coffee and getting through the headaches.

offers.text: Custom kitchens, built-ins and joinery with 20 years of experience, mostly for architects in the inner north.
Hand-cut dovetail drawers and solid hardwood work, including thick glued-up benchtops and islands.
A 140 m² shed in Brunswick with three-phase power and a private spray booth.
A Felder 3.2m sliding table saw, jointer-planer, thicknesser and edgebander. I could do contract machining, sheet cutting and edging for other makers.
A Hilux ute and a sheet-goods trailer for timber and board pickups and local deliveries.
Good relationships with two hardwood yards, in Sunshine and Thomastown. I can advise on species, grades and where to buy.
Introductions to the architects and designers I work with, once I know the person and the work.
I can explain joinery methods to apprentices or hobbyists in short, practical sessions.
I can coach junior netball, with a focus on team passing, structure and keeping a losing team's heads up.
I can explain what a long-term car restoration actually involves, the work that goes into it and what it costs.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a furniture maker in Fitzroy and I'm leaving my studio. The landlord wants it back, and I'd like to share a space with another maker for a year. Do you have room?
catchers.can: Possibly share part of the Brunswick shed, or point to makers who do have space. This would be a t1 conversation.
catchers.confirm: Do you work in solid timber or sheet-goods joinery, and can you manage without a full-time employee or weekend access?

catchers.hypo: I'm an architect in Collingwood with a kitchen and joinery set coming up this spring. The last joiner didn't work out. Can you take on a spotted gum job?
catchers.can: Quote and build high-end kitchens, built-ins and joinery with real timber and dovetailed drawers, once the Hartley job is delivered on 24 October.
catchers.confirm: Is the project in the inner north, and is the delivery date on or after mid-November?

catchers.hypo: I'm a woodworker in Preston and I need a thicknessed, jointed, edged batch of boards cut on a big sliding table saw. Do you take outside work?
catchers.can: Offer batch machining and edging on the Felder and the other machines as a paid service.
catchers.confirm: Is this a one-off job in the inner north, and does it fit within weekday hours?

catchers.hypo: My business is moving out of its workshop and we're selling machines. Do you know anyone looking for a sliding table saw, a jointer or a small CNC router?
catchers.can: Gaz, my plumber mate, already has a contact asking about a sliding table saw. I could also check whether the CNC or jointer would sell in the same circle.
catchers.confirm: Are you a buyer or a seller, and is the machine in Melbourne?

catchers.hypo: We're a small company in Brunswick looking for a larger shed and we're willing to share the rent. Could you share a space, or even take on a sublet?
catchers.can: Possibly sublet part of the Brunswick shed, or introduce others who might. Gaz and I know a lot of local tradespeople.
catchers.confirm: Would your business work around a woodworking shop's noise and dust?

catchers.hypo: I'm restoring a 1970s Holden and I'm stuck on a rusted subframe bolt and a gearbox. Can you help or point me at someone who can?
catchers.can: Swap Kingswood notes and share what worked on the seized bolt. I could also lend tools or a second pair of hands on a Sunday.
catchers.confirm: Is the car in the inner north, and is the job on a Sunday morning?

catchers.hypo: I'm a mechanic and I'd happily trade labour on a Kingswood engine rebuild for some custom joinery or cabinets. Interested?
catchers.can: Swap my cabinetmaking for your mechanical work on the engine, gearbox or axle.
catchers.confirm: Have you worked on Holden 1970s-era engines and driveline before, and are you in the inner north?

catchers.hypo: My daughter plays under-12 netball and our team needs a coach, or at least some guidance. Could you give us a few pointers?
catchers.can: Share my coaching approach and drills for junior teams, and pass on the club or rec centre contacts I know.
catchers.confirm: Is the team in the Brunswick or Coburg area, and can you work around Tuesday evenings or Saturday mornings?

catchers.hypo: I'm a small business owner in the inner north and my landlord just raised my rent by about 40%. How did you cope, and what are your options?
catchers.can: Compare notes on what I've tried: looking at other sheds, asking about equipment sales and renegotiating. I can point to local trade groups and tell you who is worth ringing.
catchers.confirm: Are you a small manufacturer or trade business in the inner north facing a lease renewal?

forbids.text: I won't work weekends, apart from Sunday mornings on the Kingswood, because of my kids.
I won't relocate or work outside the inner north of Melbourne.
I won't take shortcuts on drawer construction or cut corners on quality to hit a price.
I'm not taking on an employee for now.
I won't commit to new kitchen work with a start date before the Hartley job is delivered on 24 October.

projects.name: 1978 Holden Kingswood restoration
projects.text: A three-year restoration of a 1978 Kingswood. The shell is stripped and primed, and the matching-numbers engine is in boxes. I'd like it on the road by 2028.
roles_needed: someone with Kingswood experience who can help on Sunday mornings

policy.t1: When there's a real lead, I'll share that my lease rent is rising sharply, that I'm weighing up selling some machines, my current workload and netball commitments, and what the shed offers.
policy.t2: When the match looks strong and I know who I'm dealing with, I'll talk about the loan pressure and what selling the saw means to me.
policy.never: Exact finances and anything about my separation.
